info.title: IDPGitOps — F-001 Service onboarding pipeline events
info.description: Empty, and that is a finding rather than an omission: the survey recorded one event literal in the whole repository and it belongs to a Key Vault alert topic, not to this feature. No broker client, no publish call and no subscription appears in the onboarding modules. The pipeline's only asynchronous coupling is git itself — a merged change set is reconciled later by the GitOps engine — and a repository state change is not a message this feature emits.
